facts.fact: The CDP published its quarterly opinion for April-June 2026: 195 files handled (154 declarations, 41 authorisation requests), 153 declaration receipts and 39 authorisations issued, 2 decisions deferred, 1 processing rejected, 2 controllers heard, and 8 complaints and 1 report received and handled.
The CDP, created by law 2008-12, is described as the acting independent administrative authority, holding two plenary sessions in April-June 2026 and issuing decisions.
